document.title: Schedule K-1 (100S), Shareholder's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc. (California)
document.issued_by: California S corporation (Franchise Tax Board form)
document.notes: The California counterpart of Schedule K-1 (Form 1120-S), usually printed right after it with its own 'Additional Information From Schedule K-1' continuation. Its amounts are California amounts - they differ from the federal K-1 wherever California does not conform (depreciation, bonus depreciation, credits) - so reading it onto a federal line would double-count the federal K-1 or report state figures as federal. The federal consequence arrives on k-1-1120s.

extraction.note: Out of this map's jurisdiction (US-CA). Classifiable so it can be named and held; deliberately not extracted federally.
